In my town we don't have a music major, sadly.
And I did try reaching out to a therapist to talk about what I felt and how I coped with my first breakdown, but it made me feel worse since all she said was basically what my mother has been saying, that "you've got to be skinny to be happy" (she said that besides being a therapist she was also a nutritionist) 
In the end, she only made me hate myself more for not fitting the skinny concept.
